verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.viam.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a Viam platform summary. Viam also publishes a dedicated agent-oriented docs page, "use-viam-from-an-agent", which gives concrete guidance: list resources and status before calling, plan motion through the motion service, and restrict permissions via user_permissions. Machine-readable doc artifacts such as sitetree.json and .md tutorial pages also exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and evidence of the llms.txt depth beyond its header (e.g., a full-content variant).
